ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with a dominant low-intensity (black) central region and localized high-intensity (white) distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central 60% of visible fluke area is solid black. Distal 20% of each lobe features a high-intensity white background with dense, irregular low-intensity (black) mottling and speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; the interior angle formed by the intersection of the two lobes is approximately 40 degrees, with the base partially obscured by surface water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography exhibiting continuous, high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 3 to 15 pixels against the background sea surface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge sweep from the distal tips toward the median notch, with convex distal boundaries.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, circular high-contrast white clusters (approx. 2-6 pixel diameter) scattered across the black central ventral surface, particularly on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned dark linear streaks visible on the white pigmentation zone of the right fluke tip, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe, positioned approximately mid-way between the distal tip and the median notch, distinct from the regular serration pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian subject (bird) in flight located immediately superior to the median notch area.
